answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by enforcing a multi-hop verifiable delay route before task registration. Each identity transmits an execution signal through physical edge nodes, recording latency proofs across this network voyage. An adversary running thousands of cloned identities cannot fake disparate network paths; any hollow virtualized proxy cluster collides on identical round-trip delays and gets slashed. The attacker must purchase and maintain dedicated physical hardware and distinct transit links for each persona, imposing steep recurring capital costs per identity.
